name: WhoUsesThisBuilding
author: DeterMination + Codex
description:
[accent]EN[]
Hold the trigger hotkey while hovering any building to highlight all logic processors that reference it.
- Reverse view: from building -> processors.
- Label format: LN(opcode), for example L20(sensor).
- Supports both explicit logic links and world processor getblock(x, y) indirect access.
- Visual style follows vanilla logic link highlight, but uses [sky]sky[] blue squares.

[accent]中文[]
按住触发热键并将鼠标悬停在任意建筑上时，本模组会高亮所有引用该建筑的逻辑处理器。
- 反向显示：从建筑反查到处理器。
- 标签格式：LN(opcode)，例如 L20(sensor)。
- 同时支持显式链接和 world processor 的 getblock(x, y) 间接引用。
- 显示风格保持原版逻辑高亮，仅将方框改为 [sky]sky[] 蓝色。
